text:
sam: Dropped PR #560 with relnotes + migration guide for SDK v0.12.0. Need quick passes on snippets (Python/Go), a short migration blurb for model pinning, and link-check before merge.

anya: Scanning. Found Python snippet uses old `openai.Client()` pattern; should be `from redwood import Client`. I'll paste a minimal fixed snippet.

rob: Also saw the Go snippet forgot ctx usage and has fmt missing. Small patch incoming.

sam: Please keep snippets runnable and minimal. We prefer copy-paste examples in relnotes.

anya: Fixed Python snippet:```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="${REDWOOD_API_KEY}")
resp = client.generate("Hello")
print(resp.output_text)
```
Runs locally.

rob: Go fix:```go
package main
import (
  "context"
  "fmt"
  "github.com/redwood/redwood"
)
func main(){
  ctx:=context.Background()
  client:=redwood.NewClient("$REDWOOD_API_KEY")
  res,_:=client.Generate(ctx, "hello")
  fmt.Println(res.OutputText)
}
```
Small change, compiles.

ci-bot: Running snippet-verify + linkcheck on refs/heads/release/relnotes-560.

ci-bot: snippet-verify: Python OK, Go OK. linkcheck: found 1 external 404 -> external tutorial.

anya: Replace the 404 with the official spec link (spec.redwood.ai/model-pinning). I'll push change.

l10n-bot: Localization: phrase "fallback routing" flagged. Suggest "fallback behavior" for clearer translation. Also flag long sentence in German file.

sam: Update wording to "fallback behavior" and shorten the sentence. Also add migration KB reference KB-8234 instead of internal link.

rob: One more nit: changelog bullet uses "opt-in" for adaptive batching. Legal prefers "available via". I'll switch to "Adaptive batching available via batching.policy=adaptive."

ci-bot: Re-run: linkcheck: all links 200. snippet-verify: pass. docs-lint: one terminology warning fixed.

sam: Plan: editorial pass tomorrow morning, merge after green. Add a short "What to watch" section: increased small-batch latency spike during canary, monitor request error rate and median tail-p99 latency.

anya: I'll add the smoke-test CLI command to PR comments: `redwoodctl smoke --scenario=short-chat --wait=20s` and expected `{"status":"ok"}`.

rob: I'll also add the tiny grep check for returned JSON keys in the CI smoke script.

sam: Thanks team. If nothing else, merge after editorial sign-off. :thumbsup:
